title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4EHAW - Ban
description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4ehaw/Ban. Body Area Network (ttl rdfs:comment). Modelled as a subClassOf s4syst:Connection, with a restriction that it connectsSystem some HealthDevice. A BAN is mainly used for collecting, aggregating and relaying patient/user vital parameters (ETSI TS 103 410-8 clause 4.2.3). Ban is the range of HealthActor.usesBan.

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'Ban'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

consistsOf.description: Relationship. Model:'https://saref.etsi.org/core/consistsOf'. A Body Area Network or BAN contains one or multiple health devices. Reused SAREF core property (not redeclared locally in saref4ehaw.ttl since inherited via import); ETSI TS 103 410-8 Table 3 and Figure 3 confirm domain Ban, range HealthDevice.

hasHub.description: Relationship. Model:'https://saref.etsi.org/saref4ehaw/hasHub'. A Body Area Network or BAN elects one hub that mainly plays the role of both a data concentrator and a network gateway. ttl-confirmed, domain Ban, range BanHub (s4ehaw:hasHub).

hasResponsibleParty.description: Relationship. Model:'https://saref.etsi.org/saref4ehaw/hasResponsibleParty'. A BAN has a responsible party which plays the role of the legal entity responsible for this BAN (e.g. to contact in case of problem). ttl-confirmed, domain Ban, range ResponsibleParty (s4ehaw:hasResponsibleParty).

hasContact.description: Relationship. Model:'https://saref.etsi.org/saref4ehaw/hasContact'. A BAN has one or multiple contacts (e.g. the patient or user that is monitored through this BAN, the caregiver that is using this BAN for monitoring purposes). ttl-confirmed, domain Ban, range HealthActor (s4ehaw:hasContact).

accomplishes.description: Relationship. Model:'https://saref.etsi.org/core/accomplishes'. Links the BAN to the application task(s) it enables. Reused SAREF core property (not redeclared locally); ETSI TS 103 410-8 clause 4.2.3 and Figure 3: 'A BAN enables the execution of tasks... modelled as the following SAREF4EHAW individuals: Healthcare, Telemedicine, AssistedLiving, SportTraining, PervasiveComputing, Safety, Emergency' (the ttl additionally has an 8th individual, Prevention, not mentioned in this TS prose list).

banTopology.description: Property. Model:'https://saref.etsi.org/saref4ehaw/BanTopology'. The BAN topology type, i.e. Adhoc, Star or Mesh. ttl-confirmed State class (s4ehaw:BanTopology) and its 3 StateValue individuals; undomained by any explicit rdfs:domain, attached here to Ban by name ('BAN topology type').
